name: MARN 4050
title: Geological Oceanography
description: Concepts in geological oceanography, including the role of plate tectonics in the control of the Earth and ocean system, fundamentals of biosphere-geosphere interaction over geologic timescales, and the reconstruction of past climates using marine sediment archives.
requirement_description: ERTH 1051 or MARN/ERTH 3230 or instructor consent.
